items.ref: Nali mu South Africa nga ngenda Maputo.

items.hyp: Nnaddala nnyo bizineesi ebyo ebyo mu South Africa era n'olwekyo ennyo mu bbomasi yaweebwa omuwanga we.
items.ref: Nalina bizinensi ey'okukola mu South Africa n'okufuna ekifo ky'omwana wange mu ssomero ly'ekisulo.

items.hyp: Nze nnyo South Africa ennyo ebintu bingi.
items.ref: Nkozesa South Africa mu bintu bingi.

items.hyp: Nnagambibwa nga Lwokuna ne wannabwatuuka nga Lwokuna.
items.ref: Nnatuuka ku Lwokusatu ne nkwatibwa ku Lwomukaaga.

items.hyp: Poliisi yagamba nti ye y'omu ku bwe yasululululwa Kayumba.
items.ref: Poliisi yanvunaana ogw'okubeera omuntu eyakuba Kayumba amasasi.

items.hyp: Kati kyali kikulu Kayumba n'omu ku bo be basobola okukwatagana?
items.ref: Omanyi Kayumba era mwembiriri mubadde n'obukuubagano okuva edda?

items.hyp: N'olusibwa Kayumba mu Kitgum mu 1977, bwe yali omukungu wa disitulikiti.
items.ref: Nasooka kusisinkana Kayumba e Kitgum mu lukumi kinaana mu musanvu bwe yali akola nga amyuka akulira disitulikiti.

items.hyp: Nnaddala sergeyitii mu Battalion eyo eyo yali ekya National Riffle Association ekya 19, ekyali kubanga Uganda People Defence Force.
items.ref: Nali ssajenti mu kibinja ky'abayeekera eky'ekkumi n'omwenda ekya National Riffle Association leero ekiyitibwa Uganda People's Defence Force.

items.hyp: Mu 1990 weetendeka okuggya Gulu.
items.ref: Mu lukumi mu lwenda kyenda twadda ffenna e Gulu.

items.hyp: Nga Okitobba 1, 1990, tulwa ekitongole ky'ennyonyi eky'omutemwa gye kyali kugenda e Kagitumba bwe kyali kikola okulonda okulonda.
items.ref: Nga I Ogwekkumi 1990, twatambulira mu mmotoka emu okugenda e Kigitumba nga Rehabilitation Project Force etongoza olutabaalo.

items.hyp: Okusobola okulabula okutereka bwe kuba nti Kodak ne Fuji bwe kyali kigendererwa okukozesa okuba n'obuyambi bwa ssente.
items.ref: Okufuna ekitono mu bya ffirimu, okugeza, olw'okubaawo ebintu ebirala ebirungi ebiyinza okweyambisibwa nga Kodak ne Fuji.

items.hyp: Olw'okuba baali bamanyi mu nsi zonna ez'okukola ebintu ebirala mu Mozambique, Lebanon, Morocco ne Ethiopia, CinemArena kati mu Uganda.
items.ref: Oluvannyuma lw'okukozesebwa obulungi mu pulojekiti ezaatambula obulungi Mozambique, Lebanon, Morocco ne Ethiopia, ekisaawe ky'ebya ffirimu kimaze ne kituuka mu Uganda.

items.hyp: CinemArena mu Uganda erina emirimu gy'okukola mu by'obusuubuzi, olw'okuba Amakula Film n'omu Uganda gwe gwakakasa.
items.ref: Ekisaawe ky'ebya ffirimu mu Uganda kyetooloolera ku kukyusa mbeera z'abantu, okusiima kugende eri Italian cooperation ne Amakula Film.

items.hyp: Abantu bano mu Gulu bwe bamalawo kubanga ekitongole kye kyali kikola ku bintu bingi.
items.ref: Musanyufu nnyo n'abantu b'e Gulu pulojekiti gy'eddukanyizibwa nti tebakoma bukomi ku kutambula ngendo mpanvu okugenda mu bifo bye baagala.

items.hyp: Abantu abali mu Gulu balina okuba n'ebitundu bwe balina okutuuka ku kikumi okutuuka ku kisaawe.
items.ref: Abantu b'e Gulu bavumu mu obunnyogovu bw'ekiro okutuukira ddala mu matumbi budde.

items.hyp: CinemArena yateekateeka obuyinza obulala okuva mu kitongole ky'eby'empuliziganya ekya Italy.
items.ref: Ekisaawe ky'ebya ffirimu kivujjirirwa ekitebe kya Italy Development Cooperation office.

items.hyp: Omutima ogutandika mu butuufu n'ebirala ebitali bimu mu Uganda.
items.ref: Emmotoka y'abasuubuzi etambula yeetooloola ekibuga n'ebitundu by'ekyalo mu Uganda.

items.hyp: Abakadde b'omu Acholi abamuwa abantu okukuba emirimu gy'okuba emirimu gy'okuba emirimyako gy'okubiriza.
items.ref: Abazinyi abazina amazina Amacholi basanyusa abantu ku nnaku ez'okukola bongera okunyumisa ekintu.

items.hyp: Abakulembeze b'ekolera ebyo bagamba nti ebyo bye bivuddeko eby'okwerinda bireeseewo ebyo eby'okukozesa Barak Obama "Yes We Can" bye yali yagamba nti yali yasooka mu kifo ekyo.
items.ref: Abategesi ba pulojekiti bagamba nti omukutu gwabwe ogw'empuliziganya gwekuusa ku ngombo ya Baraka Obama eya "Yes We Can" eyamuyamba okutuuka mu woofiisi.

items.hyp: Marco Ballerini, omumyuka w'ekitongole ky'ekitongole kyagamba nti okulowooza abantu abalina ebikozesebwa ebyetaagisa okukola obuyinza mu byafaayo.
items.ref: Marco Ballerini, akulira pulojekiti yagambye nti mu kukola ekyo abantu abalina obukugu bajja kukulemberamu enkulaakulana y'omu maaso.

items.hyp: Ekitundu kye kikolebwa mu butuufu ebiri mu bitundu ebiri mu Gulu kyali kyasooka nga Jjuuni 25 ne kityo nga Jjuuni 25.
items.ref: Pulojekiti egenda okukolebwa mu magombolola agasukka amakumi abiri mu disitulikiti y'e Gulu yatandika nga abiri mu ttaano Ogwomukaaga era ya kukomekkerezebwa ng'abiri mu ttaano Ogwomusanvu.

items.hyp: Abantu abali mu Gulu abali mu kiseera kino beeyongera okuba nti banoonya.
items.ref: Abantu b'omu bitundu by'e Gulu pulojekiti gyeeri mu kukolebwa kati basanyufu nnyo.

items.hyp: Baali bamanyiddwa nti abamu ku bantu baali bamanyiddwa mu UPDF.
items.ref: Baanokolayo nti abamu ku bannaabwe baayingizibwa eggye lya Uganda People's Deforce Force.

items.hyp: Abalala baali bamanyi mu kitongole ky'eby'okwerinda ebikwata ku bantu b'eby'okwerinda, era ne basobola okukyusa abantu abaalina obukambwe bwa Moslem.
items.ref: Abalala baalina ebitongole by'ebyokwerinda bye baalinako akakwate ebyabayambanga okulondoola n'okumanyisa Abasiraamu.

items.hyp: Abamu ku ADF abasukka aba Kakooza Ahmad ne Dada Mukibi baagabwa okufuna bbomu.
items.ref: Bammemba ba Allied Democratic Forces babiri, Kakooza Ahmad ne Dada Mukibi bammiddwa looni.

items.hyp: Okuvuganya abantu okukwatira ekibiina kya Arrest Search Surveillance and Tracking e Kitante kye kyali kikola ku ky'okukwata ekibiina kya ADF.
items.ref: Woofiisi ekola ku kunoonyereza n'okulondoola e Kitante eyali ekola ku kutabaganya enkola za ADF yali tekyakola.

items.hyp: Mu kifo ky'okulwanyisa gavumenti, abantu be baali bafuusa obulumbaganyi obwali bwa ADF abali mu nsi.
items.ref: Mu kukola ne Gavumenti, obulamu bwabwe bubadde bwongedde okuteekebwa mu katyabaga okuva eri bannaabwe ba Allied Democratic Forces abakyali mu nsiko.

items.hyp: Baayogera ku ngeri bannamawulire gwe baali bafuula nga Lyavaala, Zilyawulawo, Junju, Kasakya, Issa Twatera, Benon Musisi, Kagimu.
items.ref: Baayogera ku kufa kw'ekibwatukira okwa bannaabwe nga Lyavaale, Zilyawulawo, Junju, Kasakya, Issa Twatera, Benon Musisi, Kagimu.

items.hyp: Abamu ku abo abaali bakkiriziganya baakwata era abo abali ku bantu abaali baali baakwata baali bamubuza okukola obulumbaganyi bwabwe.
items.ref: Abamu ku bannaabwe battibwa mu ngeri etaategeerekeka era abamu ku baaliko abayeekera ba Allied Democratic Forces baatiisatiisa okuttukiza ebikolwa y'obutujju.

items.hyp: Mu Okitobba 2008 abakulembeze b'eby'okwerinda baasalawo okukola ku nsonga eyo abaali baali baakigiriza gavumenti okukola abawagizi baabwe.
items.ref: Mu Gwekkumi gwa 2008, abakulira ebitongole by'ebyokwerinda baasisinkana okukubaganya ebirowoozo ku nsonga y'abaliko abayeekera ba ADF balumiriza gavumenti okubakozesa.

items.hyp: Abayeekera ba ADF baali baasibira gavumenti okukozesa abawagizi be n'okumukwatira mu ngeri.
items.ref: Abaaliko abayeekera ba Allied Democratic Forces baalumizizza gavumenti okubakozesa n'ebasuulawo nga tebasasudde.

items.hyp: Bbomu ezaabwo mu Jjulaayi nga 11 mu Kampala zikozesebwa olw'okuba abantu ab'amaanyi ab'ekibiina kya ADF ne Somalia be baali bamaze okukozesa aba Al-Shabaab.
items.ref: Obulumbanyi bwa bbomu obwali mu Kampala nga 11 Ogwomusanvu bwava ku nkolagana wakati wa ADF ne bamukwatammundu Abasiraamu aba Al-Shabaab abasangibwa e Somalia.

items.hyp: Olw'okuba abamu ku bantu ab'ebibiina b'eggwanga era nga balina obulumbaganyi obwali bannabyabufuzi aba ADF, baali basobozesebwa okuba n'obukambwe bwa bavuganya.
items.ref: Olw'embeera enzibu era ey'okwennyamira gye bawangaaliramu, bannamawulire ba Allied Democratic Forces abatamanyi kiddako baddiziddwa mu bikolwa by'obutujju.

items.hyp: Abdusalam Lukwebe Mwebe n'abalala be bamu ku bamemba ba ADF.
items.ref: Abdusalam Lukwebe Mwebe n'abalala be bamu ku baali bammemba ba Allied Democratic Forces.

items.hyp: Olupapula lwa Independent olwa Jjulaayi 2010 luwagira nti abalala b'obwa ADF tebamanyiwo bannamawulire era kati abalala be baagalawo nga bafunye mu ggwanga ly'ekitongole kya gavumenti.
items.ref: Independent w'Ogomusanvu, 2010, yawandiika nti abooluganda b'abaaliko mmemba wa ADF tebafuna buyambi kyokka ng'abaami baabwe baafiira ku mirimu gya Gavumenti.

items.hyp: Ekitongole kya Kampala City Council kyali kikola bulungi nnyo mu bantu b'e Kampala.
items.ref: Kampala City Council Authority lubeerera ekubiriza bannakampala okuba abayonjo.

items.hyp: Ekyo kyali kikola abasomesa be nga Rwigyema Shafik ne Tumusiime Hassan mu bituufu.
items.ref: Ekino kiviiriddemu bannaabwe nga Rwigyema Shafik ne Tumusiime Hassan ebuzibu.
